info.title: QuantumBilling API
info.description: Server-to-server API for one business's books. See docs/api.md for authentication, errors, idempotency and paging, and docs/webhooks.md for events. Every amount is an integer in the invoice currency's minor unit (paise for INR, fils for AED, pence for GBP, cents for EUR; 100 = one unit).

bearer.description: qb_live_… API key, in the Authorization header only

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page

CustomFields.description: The business's own fields marked "Include in API" in Settings › Data model, keyed by field key. Values: text, long_text, email, phone and url are strings; number is a decimal string; money is integer minor units of the currency (paise for INR); date is YYYY-MM-DD; boolean is true or false; select is a choice id; multi_select is a list of choice ids. When writing, a select or multi_select also accepts choice labels (any case), null clears a value, and any key not marked for the API is refused.

place_of_supply.description: GST: the state supplied to. VAT: usually null

tax_regime.description: The regime the invoice was raised under; changing the business setting never changes it

reverse_charge.description: VAT only: the customer accounts for the VAT, so none is charged

tax_breakdown.description: VAT only: one row per rate used. Empty for GST

tax_number.description: VAT: the customer's VAT number or TRN

mode.description: demo: made by the sandbox, never filed

tax_rate.description: GST slab, percent. 0 on VAT lines

tax_rate_id.description: VAT: the business tax rate chosen

tax_rate_bp.description: VAT: the rate when saved, in basis points (750 = 7.5%)

tax_category.description: VAT: standard, reduced, zero, exempt, reverse_charge or out_of_scope

tax_name.description: VAT: the rate's name when saved

valid_until.description: Local date and time, no offset (IST)

tax_rate_id.description: VAT only: a business tax rate id; defaults to the default rate

InvoiceCreate.description: The business's tax regime decides the tax fields. GST: each line takes tax_rate and place_of_supply is required. VAT: each line takes tax_rate_id (else the default rate) and the invoice may set reverse_charge. Fields of the other regime are refused.

tax_number.description: VAT businesses: the client's VAT number, checked against country

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. AE or GB

reference.description: Bank or payer reference, up to 100 characters

amount.description: Must cover the grand total (minor units; 100 = one unit)

subtotal.description: Defaults to the invoice's (minor units; 100 = one unit)

tax_total.description: Defaults to the invoice's (minor units; 100 = one unit)

grand_total.description: Defaults to the invoice's (minor units; 100 = one unit)
